title: Idaho IWTU: current-run and cumulative treatment volumes preserve separate denominators
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management
summary: DOE reports more than 130,000 gallons treated in the current processing run and nearly 400,000 gallons treated since operations began in 2023, against an approximately 900,000-gallon total mission. Denominator: Current-run gallons, cumulative gallons since 2023, and approximately 900,000 gallons of original inventory; the state plan separately requires at least 15 percent annually on a rolling three-year average.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Cleanup delivery and outcome.
